why: her apply_parsing_event_selection passes particle_counts straight to filter_events_by_particle_counts with is_particle_counts_range=True, which builds the EVENT-level mask (obj_count >= min) & (obj_count <= max) and drops events outside it -- she does NOT have PR #31's override that raises the light-jet max to infinity (no LIGHT_JET_FIELD logic in her event_selection.py at all)
and IMCalculator._is_valid_fs, with max_count_particle_in_combination = 4, would drop any surviving final state with a per-type count above that anyway

2_jet_lepton_overlap_removal.verdict: NOT APPLIED in this run, although the code for it is on her branch
2_jet_lepton_overlap_removal.how: READ (her parsing_handler.py, domain/config.py and the run config)

the run's own config snapshot has no enable_overlap_removal key (present=False), so the default False applied
